ui.title: PERKS
ui.selectNone: Select a perk in the list.
ui.ownedEmpty: No owned perks yet. Keep a perk a reroll shows to add it.
config.devMode.name: Developer mode
config.devMode.desc: Testing only. Enables the prestige chat commands (coins, perks, tiers) and [dev] diagnostic logs. Takes effect on the server right away.
config.activeTestPerk.name: Active perk test
config.activeTestPerk.desc: Developer mode only. Starts the next raid with this active perk instead of the one in the active slot (slot = the active slot). In a raid, press the reset key to switch.
config.activeTestTier.name: Active perk test tier
config.activeTestTier.desc: Developer mode only. Tier of the active perk in the next raid (0 = the tier the server applies). In a raid, press the reset key to switch.
config.activeResetKey.name: Active perk reset key
config.activeResetKey.desc: Developer mode only. In a raid: ends a running effect, switches to the test perk and tier if they changed, otherwise clears the use and cooldown.
config.markKey.name: Mark key
config.markKey.desc: Developer mode only. Takes a screenshot and logs the active perk state in one line ([active][MARK]).
config.activeKey.name: Use key
config.activeKey.desc: Key that uses the active perk in a raid. Active perks are off when the server config activePerks.enabled is false.
config.sonarBrightness.name: Sonar brightness (naked eye)
config.sonarBrightness.desc: Sonar Pulse echo brightness without night vision or thermal.
config.sonarBrightnessNight.name: Sonar brightness (night vision)
config.sonarBrightnessNight.desc: Sonar Pulse echo brightness with night vision on.
config.sonarBrightnessThermal.name: Sonar brightness (thermal)
config.sonarBrightnessThermal.desc: Sonar Pulse echo brightness with a thermal sight or goggles on.
config.sonarWaveRing.name: Sonar wave ring
config.sonarWaveRing.desc: Shows the Sonar Pulse wave as a ring at foot height. Off = echoes only.
